instructions: Speak warmly and naturally, like a friendly helpful person on the phone. Use a calm, clear pace with short pauses. Read the supplied words exactly. Pronounce Rafii as Rafi. Emphasize star without sounding robotic. No music or sound effects.

prompts.dial-acceptance: Hi, this is Rafii, your AI assistant. Press one to connect, or simply hang up to decline.
prompts.dial-inbound: Please enter or say your 12-digit agent pairing code. If you enter it on your keypad, press star when you’re done.
prompts.dial-inbound-retry: Sorry, that Agent Pairing Code did not connect. Say all 12 digits, then pause. Or enter all 12 digits on your keypad and press star.
prompts.dial-repeat: Welcome back. I’ve sent a secure verification request to your trusted device. Confirm it with Face ID, Touch ID, or your passkey to continue. To use a new Agent Pairing Code instead, press hash.
